title: Support `Sentry.SourceGenerators` via Visual Studio 2019 version 16.11
reason: The failure is in the Sentry .NET SDK's bundled Roslyn source generator during compilation. The analyzer cannot load Microsoft.CodeAnalysis 4.3.0 under Visual Studio 2019/UWP, and TreatWarningsAsErrors turns CS8032 into a build failure. This is SDK-specific rather than a Sentry SaaS application issue.
notes: Build-time .NET SDK analyzer failure. Only sentry-dotnet example in the routing dataset, so holding it out leaves zero dotnet examples.

title: Snuba seems to set timestamp_ms to a max value
reason: The failure is in Sentry’s event-detail rendering path: malformed Snuba/ClickHouse timestamp data causes the UI request to return HTTP 500. No SDK-specific ownership is indicated, and the routing history contains no transfer or ownership dispute.
notes: Self-hosted Snuba/ClickHouse timestamp error. Reporter-selected Product Area was Issues.

title: sentry import global silently drops all but one ProjectKey per project
reason: The defect is in the core global export/import relocation implementation (`ProjectKey.write_relocation_import`), not in an SDK or the self-hosted deployment wrapper. The report provides a precise reproduction and code-level failure: project-scoped get_or_create overwrites multiple keys and silently loses DSNs.
notes: Self-hosted user, but the root cause cited is in src/sentry (ProjectKey relocation import). A STAY prediction is defensible; a mismatch here is not necessarily an agent error.

title: 404 when adding a new GH repository
reason: The report is explicitly about a self-hosted deployment and a failure while configuring its GitHub repository integration. A highly similar confirmed transfer for a self-hosted repository-integration error was routed to getsentry/self-hosted.
notes: Self-hosted GitHub integration 404 with almost no detail (screenshot only). Reporter-selected Product Area was Settings - Repositories.

title: Taskworker KAFKA_TOPIC_OVERRIDES Ignored
reason: The issue is specific to a self-hosted Helm deployment and its Kafka topic-prefix configuration. The reported failure occurs in the deployed self-hosted taskworker setup under strict Kafka ACLs, so getsentry/self-hosted is the best-supported destination.
notes: Helm-chart deployment, but the analysis points to taskworker code in src/sentry. Ambiguous ownership.
